speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to narrow this down, how would you rate the intensity of this pain on a scale of 1 to 10, and exactly where does the radiation stop?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc (likely L5-S1)

Based on your report of sudden, sharp pain radiating to the foot after gym activity, I suspect a herniated disc pressing on a nerve root. To confirm this, can you tell me if you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg or foot?
